author: Mark Atwood
text: DESIGN NOTE 2026-05-12 (Mark, interactive on PKIX-j32w DANE architecture): when verify_tls_server is designed and implemented, its shape must not foreclose on DANE composition being slotted in later behind a default-on Cargo feature (per PKIX-j32w). Specifically: (1) verify_tls_server should accept hostname AND port (port is needed for TLSA query construction _<port>._<proto>.<host>); even if the initial PKIX-only implementation doesn't use port, the parameter belongs in the signature. (2) Future DANE composition wraps the call site; either via internal feature-gated DANE path inside the existing function, or via a sibling verify_tls_server_with_config that defaults DANE on. Design for the wrapping pattern, not against it. (3) Resolver injection at the wrapper layer: the eventual DANE-enabled verify_tls_server will need to accept (or default-construct) a Resolver. Don't bake assumptions that prevent this. Cross-reference: PKIX-j32w (DANE epic), PKIX-j32w.3 (pkix-chain DANE integration; depends on this bead).
